info.title: v2.ams.create_new_targeted_campaign
info.description: Create a new campaign with custom product & affiliate selections, and basic info filling.

post.description: Create a new campaign with custom product & affiliate selections, and basic info filling.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: affiliate_list
parameters.description: The list of affiliates associated with the current campaign.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Budget value set for the current campaign. Note: TH not supported

parameters.name: campaign_name
parameters.description: The name of the current campaign.

parameters.name: is_set_budget
parameters.description: Budget allocation toggle for the current campaign. Note: TH not supported

parameters.name: item_list
parameters.description: The list of items associated with the current campaign.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: period_end_time
parameters.description: The period end time of campaign, in seconds. Can set 32503651199 (2999-12-31 23:59:59) represent of no limit.

parameters.name: period_start_time
parameters.description: The period start time of campaign, in seconds.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Commission rate of current item, 1.1 means 1.1%, support two decimal places.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ams/create_new_targeted_campaign?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "affiliate_list": [
        {
            "affiliate_id": 11301234567
        }
    ],
    "budget": 500000,
    "campaign_name": "CAMPAIGN_NAME",
    "is_set_budget": true,
    "item_list": [
        {
            "item_id": 101,
            "rate": 1.1
        }
    ],
    "period_end_time": 32503651199,
    "period_start_time": 1735660800,
    "seller_message": "Hello, pleasant cooperation."
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

If error, message, fail_xx_list are all empty, it means that all settings are successful.
